name: drakuseth_up_to_two_other_targets_none
note: Drakuseth, Maw of Flames' second instance of 'target' is 'up to two' (CR 115.6): its controller sends the 4 to P1 and chooses no other target (NONE), so nothing else is dealt damage. P1 loses 4, then 7 combat damage. Red before 2026-11-13 (with this record): the trigger raised before any choice.
